cues.zh: 一个邮局职员，一个画家朋友。
cues.en: A postal worker and an artist friend.

cues.zh: 梵高为什么要为他们画肖像？
cues.en: Why did Van Gogh paint their portraits?

cues.zh: 你看，他把胡子一笔一笔画出来，把蓝色制服上的金字也画得很仔细。
cues.en: Look at the careful strokes in the beard, and the gold letters on the blue uniform.

cues.zh: 另一个人的身后，竟然是一片星空。
cues.en: Behind the other man, there is a sky full of stars.

cues.zh: 今天，我们从这两个人开始，认识梵高。
cues.en: Today, these two people will help us get to know Van Gogh.

cues.zh: 梵高是一位出生在荷兰的画家，后来在法国生活、画画。
cues.en: Van Gogh was a painter born in the Netherlands. Later, he lived and painted in France.

cues.zh: 他画过星空、麦田、花，也画过许多普通人。
cues.en: He painted stars, fields, flowers, and many ordinary people.

cues.zh: 他留下的书信，让我们知道他在想什么。
cues.en: His letters help us understand what he was thinking.

cues.zh: 今天，我们一边看画，一边读几句他的信。
cues.en: We will look at his paintings and read a few words from those letters.

cues.zh: 这个大胡子的人叫约瑟夫·鲁兰。
cues.en: The man with the big beard is Joseph Roulin.

cues.zh: 他在阿尔勒的火车站做邮件收发工作。
cues.en: He handled mail at the railway station in Arles.

cues.zh: 大家常把这幅画叫作《邮差鲁兰》。
cues.en: This painting is often called Portrait of Postman Roulin.

cues.zh: 你看他的帽子、金色纽扣，还有一笔一笔的胡子。
cues.en: Look at his cap, the gold buttons, and all those strokes in his beard.

cues.zh: 梵高在信里说，他是“一个比许多人更有意思的人”。
cues.en: Van Gogh called him “A more interesting man than many people.”

cues.zh: 他还画了鲁兰的妻子和孩子。
cues.en: He also painted Roulin's wife and children.

cues.zh: 这个住在附近的家庭，值得他一次又一次地画。
cues.en: This nearby family was worth painting again and again.

cues.zh: 这段友情还有另一面。
cues.en: There was another side to this friendship.

cues.zh: 梵高生病住院时，鲁兰和一位清洁女工帮他照看、收拾了家。
cues.en: When Van Gogh was ill and in hospital, Roulin and a cleaning woman looked after his home and put it in order.

cues.zh: 梵高把这件事写进给弟弟的信里。
cues.en: Van Gogh told his brother about it in a letter.

cues.zh: 一个人认真画朋友，朋友在他需要的时候来帮忙。
cues.en: He took care in painting his friend, and his friend helped him when he needed it.

cues.zh: 这让我们想到：爱也可以是一件很小、很实在的事。
cues.en: It reminds us that love can be a small, practical act.

cues.zh: 再看另一个人。他叫欧仁·博赫，也是画家。
cues.en: Now look at the other man. His name was Eugène Boch, and he was a painter too.

cues.zh: 梵高给这幅画起了一个名字：《诗人》。
cues.en: Van Gogh called this portrait The Poet.

cues.zh: 这里的“诗人”是画名，博赫的工作是画画。
cues.en: That was the painting's name; Boch was an artist.

cues.zh: 他穿着黄色外套，身后是深蓝的天空和小小的星星。
cues.en: He wears a yellow jacket, with a deep blue sky and small stars behind him.

cues.zh: 亮的黄色，遇到深的蓝色，让这个人一下子被我们看见。
cues.en: The bright yellow against the dark blue draws our eyes straight to him.

cues.zh: 在画这幅肖像之前，梵高写过一个想法：
cues.en: Before making this portrait, Van Gogh wrote about an idea.

cues.zh: 他想画一位艺术家朋友，把自己对朋友的爱放进画里。
cues.en: He wanted to paint an artist friend and express his love for that friend.

cues.zh: 他想让明亮的头发，衬在很深的蓝色前面，像天空里的一颗星。
cues.en: He imagined bright hair against a rich blue background, like a star in the sky.

cues.zh: 他用了几个字：“我画出无限。”
cues.en: He wrote, “I paint the infinite.”

cues.zh: 听起来有一点难。
cues.en: That sounds a little difficult.

cues.zh: 我们可以这样想：他想给珍惜的朋友，一个比房间更大的世界。
cues.en: Here is one way to picture it: a world much larger than a room, made for someone he cared about.

cues.zh: 梵高还写过：他希望画能像音乐一样，给人安慰。
cues.en: Van Gogh also wrote that he wanted a painting to offer comfort, like music.

cues.zh: 过去，一些画家用人物头后的光圈表示神圣。
cues.en: Earlier artists often used a halo behind a person's head to show holiness.

cues.zh: 梵高想用颜色的光亮，表达人物身上说不清的“永恒”。
cues.en: Van Gogh wanted glowing colour to suggest something eternal in a person.

cues.zh: 我们再看博赫：黄色外套、深蓝天空、点点星光。
cues.en: Look again at Boch: the yellow jacket, the deep blue sky, and the little stars.

cues.zh: 颜色不只告诉我们衣服是什么颜色，也能让我们有一种感受。
cues.en: Colour can show us more than the colour of clothes. It can make us feel something.

cues.zh: 珍惜一个人，也可以不用画他的脸。
cues.en: You can show care for someone without painting their face.

cues.zh: 这幅《盛开的杏花》，是梵高送给刚出生的小侄子的礼物。
cues.en: Van Gogh made Almond Blossom as a gift for his newborn nephew.

cues.zh: 蓝天下，细细的枝条开出白花。
cues.en: White flowers open on slender branches against a blue sky.

cues.zh: 一个新生命来了，他用一幅画欢迎这个孩子。
cues.en: A new life had arrived, and he welcomed the child with a painting.

cues.zh: 再看《星空》。
cues.en: Now look at The Starry Night.

cues.zh: 天空里的线条在转，地上的村庄很安静。
cues.en: Lines turn through the sky, while the village below is quiet.

cues.zh: 这幅画有梵高看到的东西，也有他的记忆和想象。
cues.en: Van Gogh brought together things he had seen, remembered, and imagined.

cues.zh: 我们可以先问：你最先看见哪里？
cues.en: Where do your eyes go first?

cues.zh: 哪条线让你觉得安静？
cues.en: Which line feels peaceful?

cues.zh: 哪条线让你觉得有力量？
cues.en: Which line feels full of energy?

cues.zh: 你可以说出自己的感受。
cues.en: You can tell us what you feel.

cues.zh: 这些画和书信，启发了我们的几节美术课，叫作《爱是永恒》。
cues.en: These paintings and letters inspired several art lessons called Love Is What Lasts.

cues.zh: 在课程里，我们也读圣经、谈信、望和爱。
cues.en: We also read the Bible and talk about faith, hope, and love.

cues.zh: 课程把这些想法放在一起，这是我们自己的信仰理解。
cues.en: Bringing these ideas together is our own Christian reading.

cues.zh: 第一节，记住一个感到被爱的时刻。
cues.en: In the first lesson, remember a moment when you felt loved.

cues.zh: 第二节，用线条和背景，画出你希望一直留下的东西。
cues.en: In the second, use lines and a background to show what you hope will last.

cues.zh: 第三节，多看一个人一会儿，再开始画。
cues.en: In the third, spend longer looking at a person before you draw.

cues.zh: 第四节，想想身边的普通人，谁值得被认真看见。
cues.en: In the fourth, think about an ordinary person who deserves our attention.

cues.zh: 还有很多课程正在构思，目的是给每个孩子的表达留一个位置，让他们的感受都被认真地看见。
cues.en: Many more lessons are being planned. The aim is to make room for every child's expression, so that their feelings are truly seen.

cues.zh: 孩子可以选自己的颜色和画法。
cues.en: Children can choose their own colours and ways of drawing.

cues.zh: 老师帮助他们把自己的想法说清楚、画出来。
cues.en: Teachers help them say and show what they mean.

cues.zh: 梵高把身边的人，留在了他的画里。
cues.en: Van Gogh kept people close to him in his paintings.

cues.zh: 轮到你时，你想认真看看谁？
cues.en: Who would you like to look at more carefully?

cues.zh: 你又想把哪个珍惜的时刻，画下来？
cues.en: What precious moment would you like to put into a picture?
